config._note: A notification trigger is a CONFIG rule: it binds a booking lifecycle event to an ordered channel-fallback list, recipient rules, rate limits, a dedupe window, opt-out policy and an optional template override. Body leads with the rule fields and their computed summaries; there is NO email leaf — this configures dispatch, it is not a mailbox. The deliveries this rule produced and the template it overrides are listed as related for verification, and the audit trail sits in a sidebar tab (rule changes to customer messaging must be evidenced under AVG).

fields.label: Event type
fields.help: Which booking lifecycle event fires this trigger (booking.created / changed / cancelled / reminder).

fields.label: Hours before start
fields.help: Only used when triggerType = booking.reminder. The notification engine schedules dispatch at bookingStart − this value (±15 min tolerance).

fields.label: Channels (priority order)
fields.help: Fallback list — engine tries channel[0]; on adapter failure advances to channel[1], …

fields.label: Recipient rules
fields.help: Ordered list of {role, channels, condition} rules. Rules with a false condition are skipped (audited as 'condition-false').

fields.label: Respect recipient opt-out
fields.help: When on (default), recipients that opted out of this trigger type are skipped (REQ-BNT-009). AVG / GDPR mandates honouring opt-out for non-transactional channels.

fields.label: Template override (slug)
fields.help: Optional per-trigger override. When empty, the engine picks the locale-matched published template from bookings-email-templates.

fields.label: Limits to one booking (slug)
fields.help: When set, this trigger only fires for that single booking — used by the per-booking modal overrides.

emergencyActions.label: Disable all triggers
emergencyActions.description: Emergency off-switch (REQ-BNT-008). Transitions every enabled trigger to disabled — no notifications dispatch until an admin re-enables them.

emergencyActions.label: Reset rate-limit counters
emergencyActions.description: Clears the per-booking-hour and per-organizer-day counters. Use after the cause of a runaway loop has been fixed.

config._note: A notification delivery is an immutable LOG record: one dispatch attempt for one recipient on one channel, with its status, skip/failure reason, retry count and dispatch-group id linking fallback attempts. Body leads with the delivery outcome; the other attempts in the same dispatch group are listed as related so an operator can follow a fallback chain. NO email leaf — this is a delivery log, not a mailbox; the audit trail sidebar tab evidences the immutable record.

fields.label: Recipient
fields.help: Raw recipient address. Auditor role only — non-auditor list view shows the masked variant.

fields.label: Dispatch group id
fields.help: Cross-links fallback attempts for the same logical dispatch.

bookingDetailActions.label: Notifications
bookingDetailActions.description: Open per-booking notification configuration. Loads triggers whose triggerType matches one of the booking lifecycle events plus any triggers scoped to this booking; lets the organiser toggle each on/off and pick its channels (REQ-BNT-007).
